property_summary: The reference contract guarantees that any settlement attempt in the same block as lockInGuess reverts (requiring block.number > lock block), while the mutant permits settling immediately, so a general fuzz test must assert that settling in the lock block reverts.
change_summary: Deleting the require checking block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block allows settling in the same block as lockInGuess, avoiding that revert.
